Akhilesh Yadav alleges inaction over 151 Ambedkar statue vandalisms in UP

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has alleged that 151 statues of B.R. Ambedkar have been vandalized in Uttar Pradesh under the current BJP rule. Yadav stated that only 14 arrests have been made in connection with these incidents. He also vowed to cut the BJP's vote share by 27,000 seats.
